body.query: =mutation campaignBulkBidsManage($offerCmsId: ID!, $offerEnabled: Boolean, $bidsList: [OfferCampaignBulkUpdateBidItemInput!]!) { offerCampaignBulkUpdateBids(input: {offerCmsId: $offerCmsId, offerEnabled: $offerEnabled, bidsList: $bidsList}) { errors } }

update_budget.note: GraphQL mutation offerCampaignBulkUpdateBids {offerCmsId: campaign_id, bidsList: [{dailyBudget}]} sets the offer-level daily budget (a decimal string, account currency); this spends money. campaign_id is the offer's legacy CMS id shown under the product name in the ACP Edge dashboard. Rejected when country-level daily budgets are already configured ('A dailyBudget cannot be set for both the offer campaign and the country code simultaneously'). Validation failures come back in `errors` (non-empty = not applied). `currency` is ignored.

body.query: =mutation campaignBulkBidsManage($offerCmsId: ID!, $offerEnabled: Boolean, $bidsList: [OfferCampaignBulkUpdateBidItemInput!]!) { offerCampaignBulkUpdateBids(input: {offerCmsId: $offerCmsId, offerEnabled: $offerEnabled, bidsList: $bidsList}) { errors } }

pause_resume.note: GraphQL mutation offerCampaignBulkUpdateBids {offerCmsId: campaign_id, offerEnabled: false|true, bidsList: []} ('offerEnabled — Optional, boolean: true enables an offer; false, disables an offer'). bidsList is a required list and is sent empty so no bid or budget changes. campaign_id is the offer's legacy CMS id. Failures come back in `errors` (non-empty = not applied).

not_offered.me: The Management API documents only the offerCampaignBulkUpdateBids mutation and a single-offer offerCampaign query that needs an offer id (https://docs.digitalturbine.com/offerwall-advertisers/advertiser-management-api); there is no account or viewer query to probe.
not_offered.list_accounts: The token 'identifies the advertiser account'; no account listing is documented (https://docs.digitalturbine.com/offerwall-advertisers/advertiser-management-api).
not_offered.list_campaigns: Only a single-offer query (offerCampaign by id or cmsId) is documented; there is no offer list query (https://docs.digitalturbine.com/offerwall-advertisers/advertiser-management-api).
not_offered.get_report: The Offerwall Reporting API is asynchronous: POST https://reporting.fyber.com/api/v1/report/offerwall?format=csv returns a URL 'to be polled (GET request) until the body response (file) is populated' within up to an hour, as CSV, with a separate client-credentials token (https://docs.digitalturbine.com/offerwall-advertisers/reporting/reporting-api).
